newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Arquati aims for bourse debut in February.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Arquati aims for bourse debut in February.

text.p: Italy's Arquati company which makes picture frames, curtains and awnings hopes to be listed on the Milan stock exchange in mid-February, chairman Franco Arquati told reporters.
The Parma-based family firm, with makes 38 percent of sales abroad, is expected to make its debut on February 17. It will hold a roadshow in London, Paris and Zurich over the coming days.
The share price, seen in a 2,000 to 2,700 lire range, will be set on January 31, global coordinator Arca Sim said. Paribas is joint lead for the institutional placing in Italy and abroad.
Some 13 million shares will be on offer, over 80 percent of which deriving from a capital increase, from February 4 to 10, equal to some 33 percent of company capital.
The group posted first half 1996 net profit of 3.1 billion lire on turnover of 79 billion lire.
